name: A new beginning
description: Log in once today. Reconnecting does not count twice.

name: Atreia patrol
description: Defeat 30 creatures no more than 10 levels below you. Nearby group credit counts.

name: A helping hand
description: Complete 3 quests through their normal turn-in.

name: Against the odds
description: Defeat 15 level-appropriate elite or stronger creatures.

name: Artisan's touch
description: Finish 20 successful crafts. Failed crafts and morphing do not count.

name: Rival encounters
description: Defeat 5 enemy-faction players within 10 levels. Each rival counts once per 30 minutes; same-account kills never count.
